release_notes: Cloaking grows an SEO-shield (Settings → Bots → Search engines): a claimed Googlebot/Bingbot/YandexBot is verified against the engine's published IP list (downloaded by the ipranges cron) and, failing that, reverse+forward DNS gated on the engine's ASN; verified crawlers get the money page and bypass geo/device targeting and the JS challenge, while a claim matching neither is the new hard signal spoofed_search_bot. New per-stream referral rule 'From search only' adds the soft signal non_search_referrer. /.well-known/traffic-advice can opt Chrome's prefetch proxy out (disallow), and the prefetch exemption itself now requires the proxy's own geofeed IP plus the Sec-Purpose: anonymous-client-ip header, closing the Translate-proxy loophole; DNS verdicts are cached on disk for a day. Fixed bot_search_verify_money being dropped by the global_settings whitelist. New partners on the wall: Loopway (code ORBITRA20, 20% off) and ZikCards (code OPENGSC, $2 off the first card). Ships with a new cloak_seo_shield regression test.
